our_interpretation: The ordinary financial reading is that its business lacked a commercially viable route to company-wide profit when the post was published.
This is assessed as an observation about viability at that time, not an unlimited prediction that the company could never become profitable.
For the ongoing financial state, use April–June 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication. The surrounding 2024 figures are historical context.
Profitability means revenue covering the company's full expenses, not merely a positive gross margin.
Nothing new supplies no objective novelty threshold and receives no separate binary grade.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable unit economics and realistic operating scenarios show that the business then lacked a workable route to covering its full expenses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched-period financial results establish company-wide profit, or a credible, costed plan demonstrates a viable route from the business then operating to company-wide profit.
